blocks.html: Victory Medical is proud to offer our Heartwise Physical in Texas. This is a specialized type of health screening that your doctor can use to analyze your risk of heart disease, stroke, or other related abnormalities which may be impairing your health and decreasing your quality of life. Heartwise is a preventative, non-invasive, head-to-toe evaluation that includes 26 tests and takes about 90 minutes to complete.

Once the test is complete, your information is evaluated by a proprietary computer program that analyzes all the tests and data. As your health status is compared with decades of information collected from patients comparable to you, variations in your profile are identified. The analysis allows your doctor at Victory Medical to determine your overall health risks, including heart disease and cancer threats, in order to create a customized treatment plan that either prevents problems from developing, or keeps them under control.
A minute of heart check up to live healthy.

Heartwise is more than just a routine physical. It is a state of the art, non-invasive exam that utilizes the information from 26 tests performed to detect health issues that may not normally be identified in a standard exam. This allows our doctors to quickly, and accurately evaluate your health and take the necessary steps to prevent disease.
Your time is valuable, and so is your health. In this short amount of time our specialized clinician will perform all the necessary tests needed to give you a full spectrum result of your health.

You are unique to every person on the planet, and you need a custom tailored treatment plan that fits YOUR health specifications. Your doctor at Victory Medical will go over your results and design a plan to optimize your health.

As a preventative measure to maintaining your best health, our Heartwise Physical is covered by most insurances. If you are uncertain if your insurance will cover, contact us, and a member of our experienced staff will help determine your coverage.
